about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (layout files, artwork, footprint geometry), 'fab' = fab_sha256 (what the manufacturer builds from a gate run: Gerber layers, drill hits, BOM and CPL rows). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (U1 T-Display pinout and the project-library footprint, C1 polarity, the 5 mm LEDs' polarity at their footprints, J1 servo pinout, the THT buttons) checked a second time independently against datasheet and footprint – e.g. by the agent electrical-reviewer
manual.note: OK for state bcb27b87… on 2026-10-31 (commits 964beec, b8f3bd1; D-23 'After the reviews'; before: OK for e4a24024… at e809b9c): R1/R2/R5 330 Ω C58608 give red/yellow 3.44–4.99 mA (LED_on ≥ 2 mA, 8 mW), R3/R4 100 Ω the yellow-green 7.25–11.23 mA (≤ 16 mA); by the XINGLIGHT datasheets (p. 3 Iv at 20 mA: SURD/UYD 400/600/900 mcd, SYGD 50–200 mcd; p. 5 the same Iv–IF curve, 0.29 at 5 mA, 0.56 at 10 mA) red/yellow 79–257 mcd (typ 136–153), yellow-green 20–124 mcd (55 mid-bin) – the gap shrank from 6–7× to 2.4–2.8×, the ranges overlap; U1's least current 0.04 A gives at least 0.136 A at usb-min idle (0.126 A without the servo) ≥ 0.1 A (D-8); its AP2112K at 184 °C/W, TJ 150 °C (Diodes DS39724 Rev. 2-2 p. 2, sha256 ef8d376f…, OTSD 160 °C) reaches at most 117 °C at usb-max/warning with i_core_a 0.27 A as the upper bound (about 70 °C in real use); edakit check 0 errors, sim 1461 of 1462 pass (servo-stalled 1.05 A as information, detached at rest); edakit order: cart_lcsc 11 lines incl. the female headers C2905419 × 10, cart_tinytronics 5 × T-Display V1.1, no stand-in in the LCSC cart; critical parts as at e4a24024 (U1 pins 1–24 = pin map, C1 + at pad 1, LED1 anode at pad 1, LED2–LED5 at pad 2, J1 1 GND / 2 +5V / 3 SIG, buttons 1–2/3–4), firmware pins = locks. Notes: red and yellow still look about 2.5× as bright as the yellow-green (about 4× with SYGD bin A1) – 470 Ω C58592 would give about 2×, 680 Ω C58599 1.3–1.5× but needs led_on_min_a 1.5 mA, judge at M-4; the module's USB-C has one CC pull-down (C-to-C powers in one plug orientation, A-to-C always); cart_tinytronics names the title, not SKU 002649; hand_assembly.md shows the stand-in C18722937 at U1, lists the female headers 'off the board' and does not say to solder the module's male headers; LCSC raises 8 of 11 cart lines to its minimum (e.g. C58608 15 → 50).

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability; hand soldering; mechanics: USB at the edge; operation of the buttons; looks of the LED row) on the manufacturing files of a gate run – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer
manual.note: OK for fab hash b768d2f5156bc767c7ed43302188f134cd773ebb3225bdbb3c7907730b44052c (gate run 20261031-154618, git e7f3f24), judged on the run's Gerber and drill files: no via, DRC 0, GND pour 91 % top / 90 % bottom without islands, copper 0.5 mm from the edge and 1.6 mm from the M3 holes, rings >= 0.26 mm, thermal spokes on every GND joint and only masked copper within 0.3 mm of the hand-soldered joints. The T-Display's USB-C end sits 0.6 mm inside the left edge, J1's servo plug keeps 2 mm to C1, START and RESET are labelled at the front right, and the LED row shows all anodes left with a '+' at each and no signal track or via; the visible top carries 0.27 m of track, mostly under the module, C1 and R8/R9. GND under the antenna end stays as decided in D-23, and the buttons' own print on their openings is D-21 (1). Notes: S1/S2's 1.3 mm holes (datasheet 1.0 mm) do not hold the snap-in legs - press the buttons flat while soldering; the stale via drill file in build/edakit/gerber_esp32tht/ was not part of the run and has been deleted.

manual.text: Regulatory review: circuit and parts against EU law for the stated purpose (RoHS, REACH, radio, batteries, product safety) – the agent regulatory-reviewer in its own session; support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed
manual.note: OK for state bcb27b87… and purpose private (renewal after D-23's second half; before: OK for e4a24024…): the change touches no regulatory duty for own use – R1/R2/R5 330 Ω C58608 (UNI-ROYAL MFR, lead-free MFR spec, no RoHS or REACH statement, not needed for own use), U1 bought from Tinytronics B.V. (NL, an EU dealer: CE marking, the EU declaration and the importer's address are LILYGO's and the importer's duties; the V1.1 is the model of BACL's RED attestation and the MIC approval with −4.32 dBi), U1's i_core_min_a and LDO data, C2895551's colour and the layout hand-over. Radio unchanged: purpose.radio U1 2412–2472 MHz, the firmware variants/esp32/firmware sets country DE with 802.11d off at every Wi-Fi start (radio off if it fails; no Bluetooth), at most about 16.2 dBm e.i.r.p. against 20 dBm (BNetzA Vfg. 91/2025), LIM.band and LIM.eirp pass; USB 5 V only, no cell, no mains. A gift needs the suppliers' SVHC statements of every part, the headers C2905419 included, and a new M-6. Notes: copper under the module's antenna end (away from USB-C) – M-5 judges it; at hand assembly C1's '+' and the module's 5V mark; erase the home Wi-Fi password before the module leaves the house; the page is open to everyone in the home network (D-17). Support, not legal advice.

manual.text: At JLCPCB after the upload: board preview and price (bare board, no assembly)

Acceptance of every soldered board: visual check, T-Display plugged in, current through USB, every LED, both buttons, the servo swings, the display shows the countdown; Wi-Fi: the setup hotspot Glocke-XXXX on channels 1–13 with WPA2, the page at glocke.local, no Bluetooth device of the bell; the module marked T-DISPLAY V1.1
